import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

wt=Path("/Users/steventran/.do_again/selfdev-20261007")
expected="0fa1a0608a98fb975f2c7387635c049578b613bb"

def run(args, check=True):
    return subprocess.run(args,cwd=wt,text=True,capture_output=True,check=check)

head=run(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"]).stdout.strip()
branch=run(["git","branch","--show-current"]).stdout.strip()
status=run(["git","status","--porcelain=v1"]).stdout.strip()
if head!=expected or branch!="feat/self-dogfood-20261007" or status:
    raise SystemExit(f"unexpected state head={head} branch={branch} status={status!r}")

remote=run(["git","remote","get-url","origin"]).stdout.strip()
print("origin="+remote)

push=run(["git","push","-u","origin","feat/self-dogfood-20261007"],check=False)
print("=== push stdout ===")
print(push.stdout)
print("=== push stderr ===")
print(push.stderr)
print("push_rc="+str(push.returncode))
if push.returncode!=0:
    raise SystemExit(push.returncode)

remote_head=run(["git","ls-remote","origin","refs/heads/feat/self-dogfood-20261007"]).stdout.strip()
print("remote_ref="+remote_head)
if expected not in remote_head:
    raise SystemExit("remote branch head does not match expected commit")

print("status_after="+repr(run(["git","status","--porcelain=v1"]).stdout))
